name: In My Airspace VR
summary:
**Live air traffic, all around you.**

In My Airspace VR shows real flights from anywhere in the world as 3D planes on a satellite map in your room. Each one is a real aircraft, in its own shape and airline colours, flying where it really is right now.

**What you can do**

- Choose your own area, or anywhere in the world, and watch the traffic come and go.
- Point at a plane to see its photo, airline, route, height and speed.
- Pull the trigger to follow a flight. The map moves along with it.
